description:
Comments on your Facebook and Instagram posts, newest first, replies included. Pass target_id — the id of one destination in a posts_list post's targets — for that delivery's thread, or account_id for everything on one account.

Threads: externalParentId names the externalCommentId of the comment it answers; null is top-level.

authorKind says who wrote it, as far as the platform would say: "account" is the connected account itself (your own reply), "person" a named member of the public, and "withheld" means the platform would not say — Facebook withholds commenters for now. Withheld is not anonymous; do not report it as such.

Read hourly for a post's first day, daily to a week, weekly to thirty days; lastSeenAt is when each was last confirmed. A comment its author deleted has goneAt set and is left out unless include_gone is true.

When nextCursor is not null there are more: pass it as cursor with the same arguments for the next page.

comment_id.description: One comment by its id from an earlier comments_list row. Every other argument is ignored.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page, for the page after it.

include_gone.description: Include comments deleted since they were read.

limit.description: How many to return. Defaults to 50.

target_id.description: One delivery: the id of a destination in a posts_list post's targets.

name: comments_list
title: List comments
